form: A complete answer must give an explicit description of the set \(\mathcal S_r\subseteq[0,\infty)\) for every integer \(r\ge2\), specifying exactly which real numbers belong to it and whether each finite boundary point is included.
not_enough: Bounds or partial inclusions for \(\mathcal S_r\), an unspecified threshold, a description that leaves boundary membership unresolved, results for only some values of \(r\), or a conjectural or conditional characterization would not settle the question.
